subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview-tour first-run experience be rebased and adopted on top of the current onboarding refresh, narrowed into smaller follow-ups, or paused in favor of the newer onboarding direction?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only mechanical: this protected PR adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode while current main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, and fresh first-run/configured-user simulator proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to focused follow-ups
options.body: Extract only the sample-preview pieces maintainers still want and leave connection-path and short-code work to the narrower open iOS onboarding PRs.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat the merged onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the preview-tour product surface is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, and fresh first-run/configured-user simulator proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent current-main configured-gateway startup routing fixes are on the same user-path boundary and make steipete the clearest routing decision owner from history.
